housing: Oakland renters mostly live in pre-1983 apartment buildings, duplexes and Victorian or Craftsman houses, many of them covered by the city's rent rules.

localRules.text: Oakland landlords must give new tenants the city's Notice to Tenants of the Rent Adjustment Program in English, Spanish and Chinese at move-in.
In Oakland, no rent increase can take effect until at least six months after the tenant first received the Rent Adjustment Program notice.

tenantHelp.name: Oakland Rent Adjustment Program
tenantHelp.what: city office for rent and eviction rules

climate: Most older Oakland buildings have no air conditioning; check heaters, look for damp and mold in bathrooms, and ask about earthquake retrofits in soft-story buildings.
fact: Keep the Rent Adjustment Program notice your landlord gives you at move-in: without it, you get more time to file a petition about a rent increase.
